notes: sabado.pt (Cofina/Impresa platform). Route: robots.txt is 404 (assumed open). The homepage links to a per-DAY Google News sitemap endpoint https://www.sabado.pt/sitemap?yyyy=YYYY&mm=MM&dd=DD - one request per day, 31 requests for the whole window, all status 200, ~46s total. Each <url> carries <news:publication_date> nested under <news:news><news:publication> (two levels deep - first parse attempt got 0 URLs from direct children only; fixed with uel.iter()). Listed date = publication_date date-part (site-local +01:00/+02:00); verified == page JSON-LD datePublished exactly on 8 spot-checked samples across /ultima-hora, /gps, /social, /comunicados-imprensa, /podcasts, /c-studio, /fotografias, /cartoon, /viajante, /sabado-labs-iniciativas. Excluded /video/detalhe/ (486 URLs; pages return 200 but contain only a VideoObject with no date anywhere - would fail a page-date check) and /newsletter/ (2 URLs, detail pages 404). Result: 1358 unique URLs, 31/31 days with 36-95 per day; required days 09-30=69, 10-10=62, 10-20=91. 2026-09-25's sitemap is genuinely empty (site started publishing into the window on 09-26). /rss exists but only holds 20 same-day items, no pagination, so useless for a 31-day window.
